description: This file defines the partial class GraphingSettings, which is a user control for managing graphing settings in a calculator application. It includes properties, methods for UI interactions, theme management, and resource handling related to graphing configuration.

classes.name: GraphingSettings
classes.description: A user control class for managing graphing settings, including theme, line width, and resource-based styling.

methods.name: GraphingSettings
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view model and default theme matching setting.

methods.name: SelectTextBoxStyle
methods.description: Returns a style resource for a text box, applying error styles if needed.

methods.name: SetGrapher
methods.description: Associates a GraphControl.Grapher instance with the view model.

methods.name: RefreshRanges
methods.description: Resets the view model to refresh range settings.

methods.name: GetLineWidthAutomationName
methods.description: Returns a resource string describing the line width based on the width value.

methods.name: SetGraphTheme
methods.description: Sets the graph theme matching preference and updates local settings, also triggers an event.
